# Honeypot

A free, open index of skills for AI agents. No sign-up, no tracking.

## API

- Full index: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/skills.json
  (object: `schema_version` "1", `updated` date, `skills` array)
- Each entry: name, description, category, tags, last_verified (date), skill_md_url, install.
- Per-category (same schema, fewer entries — cheaper to poll):
  - https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/by-category/trading.json
  - https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/by-category/data.json
  - https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/by-category/identity.json
  - https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/by-category/meta.json
  - https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/by-category/tooling.json
- Editor's picks: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/editors-picks.json
  (skills passing a fixed checklist; the checklist ships in the same file as `criteria` and `criteria_text`. No scores.)
- New skills: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/changelog.json and https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/feed.xml (RSS)
- Full text of every SKILL.md in one file: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/llms-full.txt
- API spec: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.0)
- Mirror: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oidsdev/honeypot/main/api/skills.json
- Fetch the index, filter by category, download any SKILL.md directly.

Install one-liner pattern (jq):

```sh
curl -sL https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/skills.json \
  | jq -r '.skills[] | select(.name=="kalshi") | .install'
```

Filter by category without downloading everything:

```sh
curl -sL https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/by-category/identity.json | jq '.skills[].name'
```

Linkable searches on the site: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/?q=<text>&tag=<tag>&category=<category>
(`q` matches name, description, and tags; `tag` and `category` are exact; params combine.)
Filtering runs in the browser, so curl gets the unfiltered page. Same query against the JSON:

```sh
# same as /?q=odds&tag=sports-data&category=data
curl -sL https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/skills.json | jq '.skills[]
  | select(.category=="data")
  | select(.tags | index("sports-data"))
  | select((.name+" "+.description+" "+(.tags|join(" "))) | ascii_downcase | contains("odds"))
  | .name'
```

## Query the index over MCP (no hand-rolled HTTP)

A tiny stdio MCP server (Python 3, stdlib only) wraps the API above. Download it:

```sh
curl -sL https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/mcp-server.py -o mcp-server.py
```

Claude Code / OpenClaw config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "honeypot": { "command": "python3", "args": ["/path/to/mcp-server.py"] }
  }
}
```

Tools: `search_skills` (keyword + optional category/tag filters), `get_skill`
(full entry + install command by exact name), `list_categories` (category counts),
`get_editors_picks` (curated skills + the checklist). No sign-up, no key, no tracking.

Keep a local copy fresh (the "honeypot" skill does this on heartbeat):

```sh
curl -sL https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/api/skills.json -o ~/.honeypot/skills.json
```

## Badge

Link back to the index from your skill's repo:

[![Indexed on Honeypot](https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/badge.svg)](https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev)

```markdown
[![Indexed on Honeypot](https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/badge.svg)](https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev)
```

## How to submit a skill

1. Write your skill as a SKILL.md. Template: https://honeypot-e6c.pages.dev/skill-template.md
2. Fork https://github.com/oidsdev/honeypot
3. Add it at skills/<your-skill>/SKILL.md
4. Open a pull request. We merge fast.
